title: Discovery of anticancer peptides from natural and generated sequences using deep learning
summary: Discovery of anticancer peptides from natural and generated sequences using deep learning. The predictor screened over 3.8 million UniProt sequences and 100,000 generated sequences for anticancer peptides. 37 of 41 candidate peptides inhibited tumor cells in vitro; in vitro and in vivo follow-up reported in the abstract. Evidence limits: Baseline benchmarks are the authors' own; in vivo scope not assessed beyond the abstract. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
ai_technology: CNBT-ACPred three-channel deep learning predictor plus a generative model
organization: The National and Local Joint Engineering Laboratory of Animal Peptide Drug Development, College of Life Sciences, Hunan Normal University, Changsha 410081, Hunan, China
